<Window x:Class="MhwModManager.App.MainWindow"
        xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        Title="{Binding WindowTitle}"
        Width="1480" Height="900" MinWidth="1040" MinHeight="700"
        WindowStartupLocation="CenterScreen">
    <Window.InputBindings>
        <KeyBinding Key="Enter" Modifiers="Control" Command="{Binding ApplyCommand}"/>
        <KeyBinding Key="Z" Modifiers="Control" Command="{Binding UndoCommand}"/>
        <KeyBinding Key="F5" Command="{Binding RefreshAnalysisNowCommand}"/>
    </Window.InputBindings>
    <Grid>
        <Grid.RowDefinitions>
            <RowDefinition Height="94"/>
            <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
            <RowDefinition Height="32"/>
        </Grid.RowDefinitions>

        <!-- Top command bar -->
        <Border Grid.Row="0" Background="#0D1117" BorderBrush="{StaticResource Border}" BorderThickness="0,0,0,1">
            <Grid Margin="20,0">
                <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                    <RowDefinition Height="50"/>
                    <RowDefinition Height="43"/>
                </Grid.RowDefinitions>

                <Grid>
                    <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="440"/>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                    </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center" MaxWidth="440" HorizontalAlignment="Left">
                        <Border Width="42" Height="42" CornerRadius="9" Background="{StaticResource AccentDim}" BorderBrush="#665020" BorderThickness="1">
                            <TextBlock Text="UM" Foreground="{StaticResource AccentBright}" FontSize="15" FontWeight="Bold" HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                        </Border>
                        <StackPanel Margin="12,0,0,0" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                            <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                                <TextBlock Text="Universal Mod Manager" Foreground="{StaticResource Text}" FontSize="18" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
                                <Border Margin="10,1,0,0" Padding="7,2" CornerRadius="10" Background="#231F15" BorderBrush="#4A3A1E" BorderThickness="1">
                                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding CurrentProgramBuildText}" Foreground="{StaticResource AccentBright}" FontSize="10" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
                                </Border>
                            </StackPanel>
                            <TextBlock MaxWidth="350" Margin="0,3,0,0" Foreground="{StaticResource Muted}" FontSize="12" Text="{Binding HeaderSummary}" TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis" ToolTip="{Binding HeaderSummary}"/>
                        </StackPanel>
                    </StackPanel>
                    <StackPanel Grid.Column="1" Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center" HorizontalAlignment="Right">
                        <Button Content="Launch Game" Command="{Binding LaunchModdedCommand}" Style="{StaticResource PrimaryButton}" ToolTip="Back up your saves, check the setup, and launch the game with your enabled mods."/>
                        <Button Content="Apply Mod Changes" Command="{Binding ApplyCommand}" Margin="8,0,0,0" ToolTip="Safely install your pending mod changes. Ctrl+Enter."/>
                    </StackPanel>
                </Grid>

                <Grid Grid.Row="1">
                    <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                    </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                        <TextBlock Text="GAME" Style="{StaticResource Eyebrow}" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,9,0"/>
                        <ComboBox Width="180" ItemsSource="{Binding Games}" SelectedItem="{Binding SelectedGame,Mode=TwoWay}" DisplayMemberPath="DisplayName" AutomationProperties.Name="Active game" ToolTip="Each game has an isolated mod library, database, rollback history, and conflict state."/>
                        <Button Content="Use This Game" Command="{Binding SwitchGameCommand}" Style="{StaticResource QuietButton}" Margin="6,0,0,0"/>
                    </StackPanel>
                    <StackPanel Grid.Column="1" Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center" HorizontalAlignment="Center">

                        <Button Content="Add Game" Command="{Binding AddGameCommand}" Style="{StaticResource QuietButton}" ToolTip="Add any Windows game by choosing its executable."/>
                        <Button Content="Game Settings" Command="{Binding ConfigureGameCommand}" Style="{StaticResource QuietButton}"/>
                        <Button Content="Launch Without Mods" Command="{Binding LaunchSafeModeCommand}" Style="{StaticResource QuietButton}" ToolTip="Start the game once without manager-controlled mods, then restore your normal setup afterward."/>

                        <Button Content="Catalog" Click="OpenCatalogClick" Style="{StaticResource PrimaryButton}" ToolTip="Browse supported mod providers, choose exact files, and install through the manager."/>
                        <Button Content="Import" Command="{Binding ImportArchiveCommand}" Style="{StaticResource QuietButton}" ToolTip="Import a mod archive into this game's managed library."/>

>>>>>>> 4f35fbda (Catalog: expose browse entry point in main UI)
                    </StackPanel>
                </Grid>
            </Grid>
        </Border>

        <!-- Sidebar + pages -->
        <TabControl Grid.Row="1" TabStripPlacement="Left" SelectedIndex="{Binding SelectedTab}">
            <TabItem Header="Dashboard">
                <Grid HorizontalAlignment="Stretch">
                <ScrollViewer x:Name="DashboardScroll" VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto" HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled">
                    <Grid Width="{Binding ViewportWidth,ElementName=DashboardScroll}" MaxWidth="1324" HorizontalAlignment="Left">
                    <Grid Margin="30,28,34,34">
                        <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                        </Grid.RowDefinitions>

                        <StackPanel>
                            <TextBlock Text="Dashboard" Style="{StaticResource PageTitle}"/>
                            <TextBlock Text="See whether your setup is ready to play and what needs your attention." Style="{StaticResource PageSubtitle}"/>
                        </StackPanel>

                        <UniformGrid Grid.Row="1" Columns="2" Margin="-5,19,-5,13">
                            <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}" Margin="5">
                                <Grid>
                                    <Grid.ColumnDefinitions><ColumnDefinition Width="5"/><ColumnDefinition Width="*"/></Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                    <Border Background="{StaticResource Good}" CornerRadius="3"/>
                                    <StackPanel Grid.Column="1" Margin="15,0,0,0">
                                        <TextBlock Text="ACTIVE MODS" Style="{StaticResource Eyebrow}"/>
                                        <TextBlock Text="{Binding EnabledCount}" FontSize="32" FontWeight="SemiBold" Margin="0,6,0,0"/>
                                        <TextBlock Text="mods enabled for this setup" Foreground="{StaticResource Muted}" FontSize="11" TextWrapping="Wrap"/>
                                    </StackPanel>
                                </Grid>
                            </Border>
                            <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}" Margin="5">
                                <Grid>
                                    <Grid.ColumnDefinitions><ColumnDefinition Width="5"/><ColumnDefinition Width="*"/></Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                    <Border Background="#6FA6E8" CornerRadius="3"/>
                                    <StackPanel Grid.Column="1" Margin="15,0,0,0">
                                        <TextBlock Text="WORKING IN GAME" Style="{StaticResource Eyebrow}"/>
                                        <TextBlock Text="{Binding FullyEffectiveCount}" FontSize="32" FontWeight="SemiBold" Margin="0,6,0,0"/>
                                        <TextBlock Foreground="{StaticResource Muted}" FontSize="11" TextWrapping="Wrap"><Run Text="{Binding ComposedCount,Mode=OneWay}"/><Run Text=" partly replaced • "/><Run Text="{Binding RevalidationCount,Mode=OneWay}"/><Run Text=" need a check"/></TextBlock>
                                    </StackPanel>
                                </Grid>
                            </Border>
                            <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}" Margin="5">
                                <Grid>
                                    <Grid.ColumnDefinitions><ColumnDefinition Width="5"/><ColumnDefinition Width="*"/></Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                    <Border Background="{StaticResource Warn}" CornerRadius="3"/>
                                    <StackPanel Grid.Column="1" Margin="15,0,0,0">
                                        <TextBlock Text="NEEDS ATTENTION" Style="{StaticResource Eyebrow}"/>
                                        <TextBlock Text="{Binding BlockerCount}" FontSize="32" FontWeight="SemiBold" Foreground="{StaticResource Warn}" Margin="0,6,0,0"/>
                                        <TextBlock Text="problems that need a choice" Foreground="{StaticResource Muted}" FontSize="11" TextWrapping="Wrap"/>
                                    </StackPanel>
                                </Grid>
                            </Border>
                            <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}" Margin="5">
                                <Grid>
                                    <Grid.ColumnDefinitions><ColumnDefinition Width="5"/><ColumnDefinition Width="*"/></Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                    <Border Background="{StaticResource Accent}" CornerRadius="3"/>
                                    <StackPanel Grid.Column="1" Margin="15,0,0,0">
                                        <TextBlock Text="READY TO APPLY" Style="{StaticResource Eyebrow}"/>
                                        <TextBlock Text="{Binding StagedCount}" FontSize="32" FontWeight="SemiBold" Foreground="{StaticResource AccentBright}" Margin="0,6,0,0"/>
                                        <TextBlock Text="mod changes waiting to be installed" Foreground="{StaticResource Muted}" FontSize="11" TextWrapping="Wrap"/>
                                    </StackPanel>
                                </Grid>
                            </Border>
                        </UniformGrid>

                        <Grid Grid.Row="2">
                            <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                                <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                                <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                            </Grid.RowDefinitions>
                            <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}">
                                <StackPanel>
                                    <Grid>
                                        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions><ColumnDefinition Width="*"/><ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/></Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                        <StackPanel>
                                            <TextBlock Text="System status" Style="{StaticResource SectionTitle}"/>
                                            <TextBlock Text="Is everything ready to play?" Style="{StaticResource PageSubtitle}"/>
                                        </StackPanel>
                                        <Border Grid.Column="1" Padding="9,4" CornerRadius="12" Background="#13241C" BorderBrush="#28553E" BorderThickness="1" VerticalAlignment="Top">
                                            <TextBlock Text="MANAGER" Foreground="{StaticResource Good}" FontSize="10" FontWeight="Bold"/>
                                        </Border>
                                    </Grid>
                                    <Border Margin="0,18,0,0" Padding="14" Background="#0D1218" CornerRadius="7" BorderBrush="{StaticResource Border}" BorderThickness="1">
                                        <TextBlock Text="{Binding StatusText}" TextWrapping="Wrap" LineHeight="20"/>
                                    </Border>
                                    <TextBlock Margin="0,13,0,0" Foreground="{StaticResource Muted}" TextWrapping="Wrap" Text="{Binding GamePathText}"/>
                                    <TextBlock Margin="0,6,0,0" Foreground="{StaticResource Muted}" TextWrapping="Wrap" Text="{Binding UnmanagedAdoptionLabel}"/>
                                    <TextBlock Margin="0,12,0,0" Foreground="{StaticResource AccentBright}" TextWrapping="Wrap" Text="{Binding ProgramUpdateStatus}"/>
                                    <TextBlock Margin="0,4,0,0" Foreground="{StaticResource Muted}" FontSize="11" TextWrapping="Wrap" Text="{Binding LatestProgramBuildText}"/>
                                </StackPanel>
                            </Border>

                            <Border Grid.Row="1" Margin="0,12,0,0" Style="{StaticResource Card}">
                                <StackPanel>
                                    <TextBlock Text="Start here" Style="{StaticResource SectionTitle}"/>
                                    <TextBlock Text="The actions most people need day to day." Style="{StaticResource PageSubtitle}"/>
                                    <Button Margin="0,17,0,7" HorizontalContentAlignment="Left" Content="Launch Game" ToolTip="Back up your save, check the mod setup, and launch with enabled mods." Command="{Binding LaunchModdedCommand}" Style="{StaticResource PrimaryButton}"/>
                                    <Button Margin="0,0,0,7" HorizontalContentAlignment="Left" Content="Install Mod" Command="{Binding ImportArchiveCommand}" ToolTip="Choose a downloaded mod archive and add it to this game's library."/>
                                    <Button Margin="0,0,0,7" HorizontalContentAlignment="Left" Content="Apply Mod Changes" Command="{Binding ApplyCommand}" ToolTip="Safely update the game files to match your pending mod choices."/>
                                    <Button Margin="0,0,0,0" HorizontalContentAlignment="Left" Content="Preview Mod Changes" Command="{Binding PreviewApplyCommand}" ToolTip="See what would change without editing game files."/>
                                    <Expander Header="More tools" Margin="0,15,0,0" Foreground="{StaticResource Text}">
                                        <StackPanel Margin="0,10,0,0">
                                            <Button Margin="0,0,0,7" HorizontalContentAlignment="Left" Content="Install Mods from Inbox" Command="{Binding ProcessInboxCommand}" ToolTip="Process multiple mod files or folders placed in the Inbox."/>
                                            <Button Margin="0,0,0,7" HorizontalContentAlignment="Left" Content="Restore Last Working Setup" Command="{Binding RestoreLastGoodCommand}" ToolTip="Return to the most recent mod setup that successfully started the game."/>
                                            <Button Margin="0,0,0,7" HorizontalContentAlignment="Left" Content="Find Mod Causing Startup Crash" Command="{Binding AutoDiagnoseCrashCommand}" ToolTip="Test recently enabled mods to narrow down which one prevents the game from starting."/>
                                            <Button Margin="0,0,0,7" HorizontalContentAlignment="Left" Content="Clean Up Duplicate Mods" Command="{Binding SmartCleanupCommand}"/>
                                            <Button Margin="0,0,0,7" HorizontalContentAlignment="Left" Content="Export Mod List" Command="{Binding ExportRecipeCommand}"/>
                                            <Button Margin="0,0,0,7" HorizontalContentAlignment="Left" Content="Review Shared Files" Command="{Binding ShowOverlapsCommand}" ToolTip="See files changed by more than one mod and which version the game will use."/>
                                            <Button Margin="0,0,0,7" HorizontalContentAlignment="Left" Content="Check for App Updates" Command="{Binding CheckForProgramUpdatesCommand}"/>
                                            <Button Margin="0" HorizontalContentAlignment="Left" Content="Advanced Tools & Diagnostics" Command="{Binding OpenWorkflowsCommand}"/>
                                        </StackPanel>
                                    </Expander>
                                </StackPanel>
                            </Border>
                        </Grid>

                        <Border Grid.Row="3" Style="{StaticResource Card}" Margin="0,12,0,0">
                            <Grid>
                                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions><ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/><ColumnDefinition Width="*"/></Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <Border Width="36" Height="36" CornerRadius="18" Background="{StaticResource AccentDim}" VerticalAlignment="Top">
                                    <TextBlock Text="i" Foreground="{StaticResource AccentBright}" FontWeight="Bold" FontSize="16" HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                                </Border>
                                <StackPanel Grid.Column="1" Margin="14,0,0,0">
                                    <TextBlock Text="How conflicts are handled" Style="{StaticResource SectionTitle}"/>
                                    <TextBlock Margin="0,7,0,0" Foreground="{StaticResource Muted}" TextWrapping="Wrap" LineHeight="19"
                                               Text="The manager resolves safe, obvious mod relationships automatically and asks you only when two unrelated mods really need a winner. Your saved choices are remembered, and technical file details stay available when you want them."/>
                                </StackPanel>
                            </Grid>
                        </Border>
                    </Grid>
                    </Grid>
                </ScrollViewer>
                </Grid>
            </TabItem>

            <TabItem Header="Mods">
                <Grid Width="{Binding ActualWidth,RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContentPresenter}}" HorizontalAlignment="Stretch">
                <Grid Margin="28,20,32,20">
                    <Grid.RowDefinitions><RowDefinition Height="Auto"/><RowDefinition Height="Auto"/><RowDefinition Height="*"/><RowDefinition Height="Auto"/></Grid.RowDefinitions>
                    <Grid>
                        <Grid.RowDefinitions><RowDefinition Height="Auto"/><RowDefinition Height="Auto"/></Grid.RowDefinitions>
                        <StackPanel>
                            <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                                <TextBlock Text="Mods" Style="{StaticResource PageTitle}"/>
                                <Border Margin="12,5,0,0" Style="{StaticResource StatusBadge}" VerticalAlignment="Top">
                                    <TextBlock Foreground="{StaticResource Muted}" FontSize="11" FontWeight="SemiBold" Text="{Binding InstalledCountLabel,Mode=OneWay}"/>
                                </Border>
                            </StackPanel>
                            <TextBlock Text="Stage what you want active, inspect the result, then apply once." Style="{StaticResource PageSubtitle}" TextWrapping="Wrap"/>
                        </StackPanel>
                        <WrapPanel Grid.Row="1" Margin="0,10,0,0" HorizontalAlignment="Left">
                            <Button Content="Check Mod Info" Command="{Binding SyncMetadataCommand}" Style="{StaticResource QuietButton}" ToolTip="Refresh mod names, artwork, known relationships, and update availability."/>
                            <Button Content="Bring In Manual Mods" Command="{Binding AdoptManualFilesCommand}" ToolTip="Copy unmanaged files from this game profile's configured mod folder into a tracked source package without modifying the live tree."/>
                        </WrapPanel>
                    </Grid>

                    <Border Grid.Row="1" Margin="0,14,0,10" Style="{StaticResource SubtleCard}">
                        <Grid>
                            <Grid.RowDefinitions><RowDefinition Height="Auto"/><RowDefinition Height="Auto"/></Grid.RowDefinitions>
                            <Grid>
                                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions><ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/><ColumnDefinition Width="*"/><ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/></Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <StackPanel Margin="0,0,12,0" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                    <TextBlock Text="SEARCH MODS" Style="{StaticResource Eyebrow}"/>
                                    <TextBlock Margin="0,2,0,0" Foreground="{StaticResource Muted}" FontSize="10" Text="Ctrl+F"/>
                                </StackPanel>
                                <TextBox x:Name="ModSearchBox" Grid.Column="1" Text="{Binding SearchText,UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}" AutomationProperties.Name="Search mods" ToolTip="Search mod name, add-on, category, source, or problem. Ctrl+F jumps here."/>
                                <Border Grid.Column="2" Margin="12,0,0,0" Style="{StaticResource StatusBadge}">
                                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                                        <TextBlock Foreground="{StaticResource Muted}" FontSize="11" FontWeight="SemiBold"><Run Text="{Binding VisibleModCount,Mode=OneWay}"/><Run Text=" shown · "/></TextBlock>
                                        <TextBlock Foreground="{StaticResource AccentBright}" FontSize="11" FontWeight="SemiBold">
                                            <TextBlock.Style>
                                                <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                                                    <Setter Property="Text" Value="All mods"/>
                                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding ModViewMode}" Value="Enabled"><Setter Property="Text" Value="Enabled"/></DataTrigger>
                                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding ModViewMode}" Value="Staged"><Setter Property="Text" Value="Pending changes"/></DataTrigger>
                                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding ModViewMode}" Value="Updates"><Setter Property="Text" Value="Updates"/></DataTrigger>
                                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding ModViewMode}" Value="Issues"><Setter Property="Text" Value="Problems"/></DataTrigger>
                                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding ModViewMode}" Value="Revalidate"><Setter Property="Text" Value="Needs check"/></DataTrigger>
                                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding ModViewMode}" Value="Superseded"><Setter Property="Text" Value="Not currently used"/></DataTrigger>
                                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                                </Style>
                                            </TextBlock.Style>
                                        </TextBlock>
                                    </StackPanel>
                                </Border>
                            </Grid>
                            <Grid Grid.Row="1" Margin="0,12,0,0">
                                <Grid.RowDefinitions><RowDefinition Height="Auto"/><RowDefinition Height="Auto"/></Grid.RowDefinitions>
                                <StackPanel>
                                    <TextBlock Text="FILTERS" Style="{StaticResource Eyebrow}" Margin="4,0,0,5"/>
                                    <WrapPanel>
                                            <Button Content="{Binding AllViewLabel}" Command="{Binding SetModViewCommand}" CommandParameter="All" Style="{StaticResource QuietButton}" ToolTip="Show every mod in this library."/>
                                            <Button Content="{Binding EnabledViewLabel}" Command="{Binding SetModViewCommand}" CommandParameter="Enabled" Style="{StaticResource QuietButton}" ToolTip="Show mods that are enabled in the pending setup."/>
                                            <Button Content="{Binding StagedViewLabel}" Command="{Binding SetModViewCommand}" CommandParameter="Staged" Style="{StaticResource QuietButton}" ToolTip="Show only unapplied changes."/>
                                            <Button Content="{Binding UpdatesViewLabel}" Command="{Binding SetModViewCommand}" CommandParameter="Updates" Style="{StaticResource QuietButton}" ToolTip="Show mods with detected Nexus updates."/>
                                            <Button Content="{Binding IssuesViewLabel}" Command="{Binding SetModViewCommand}" CommandParameter="Issues" Style="{StaticResource QuietButton}" ToolTip="Show mods with saved crash or graphics-problem evidence."/>
                                            <Button Content="{Binding RevalidateViewLabel}" Command="{Binding SetModViewCommand}" CommandParameter="Revalidate" Style="{StaticResource QuietButton}" ToolTip="Show mods that should be checked again after a game update."/>
                                            <Button Content="{Binding SupersededViewLabel}" Command="{Binding SetModViewCommand}" CommandParameter="Superseded" Style="{StaticResource QuietButton}" ToolTip="Show enabled mods whose files are completely replaced by other enabled mods."/>
                                    </WrapPanel>
                                </StackPanel>
                                <StackPanel Grid.Row="1" Margin="0,10,0,0">
                                    <TextBlock Text="BULK ACTIONS · VISIBLE MODS" Style="{StaticResource Eyebrow}" Margin="4,0,0,5"/>
                                    <WrapPanel>
                                        <Button Content="Enable Visible Mods" Command="{Binding EnableSelectedCommand}" ToolTip="Turn on every mod currently shown by the search and filters."/>
                                        <Button Content="Disable Visible Mods" Command="{Binding DisableSelectedCommand}" ToolTip="Turn off every mod currently shown by the search and filters."/>
                                        <Button Content="Refresh Mod Info" Command="{Binding ReindexSelectedCommand}" Style="{StaticResource QuietButton}" ToolTip="Re-read the files and information for every mod currently shown."/>
                                    </WrapPanel>
                                </StackPanel>
                            </Grid>
                        </Grid>
                    </Border>

                    <Grid Grid.Row="2">
                        <Border CornerRadius="9" ClipToBounds="True" BorderBrush="{StaticResource Border}" BorderThickness="1">
                        <DataGrid ItemsSource="{Binding ModsView}" SelectedItem="{Binding SelectedMod,Mode=TwoWay}" SelectionMode="Extended" AutoGenerateColumns="False" IsReadOnly="False" RowDetailsVisibilityMode="VisibleWhenSelected" RowHeight="58" AutomationProperties.Name="Mod library">
                            <DataGrid.RowDetailsTemplate>
                                <DataTemplate>
                                    <Border Margin="72,2,18,10" Padding="14" Background="#0D1217" BorderBrush="{StaticResource Border}" BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="8">
                                        <StackPanel>
                                            <TextBlock Text="Mod preview" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
                                            <TextBlock Margin="0,3,0,8" Foreground="{StaticResource Muted}" FontSize="11" Text="Cached Nexus artwork and screenshots found inside the source packages. Select a mod to load its gallery."/>
                                            <ItemsControl ItemsSource="{Binding GalleryPaths}" Margin="0,0,0,14">
                                                <ItemsControl.ItemsPanel><ItemsPanelTemplate><WrapPanel/></ItemsPanelTemplate></ItemsControl.ItemsPanel>
                                                <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                                                    <DataTemplate>
                                                        <Border Width="156" Height="102" Margin="0,0,8,8" CornerRadius="6" Background="#090D12" BorderBrush="{StaticResource Border}" BorderThickness="1" ClipToBounds="True">
                                                            <Image Source="{Binding Converter={StaticResource SafeImage}}" Stretch="UniformToFill" ToolTip="{Binding}"/>
                                                        </Border>
                                                    </DataTemplate>
                                                </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                                            </ItemsControl>
                                            <TextBlock Text="Advanced mod options" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
                                            <TextBlock Margin="0,3,0,10" Foreground="{StaticResource Muted}" FontSize="11" Text="The main toggle controls the whole mod. Open these options only when you want to turn individual add-ons or components on or off."/>
                                            <ItemsControl ItemsSource="{Binding Parts}">
                                                <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                                                    <DataTemplate>
                                                        <Grid Margin="0,3">
                                                            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions><ColumnDefinition Width="34"/><ColumnDefinition Width="2*"/><ColumnDefinition Width="110"/><ColumnDefinition Width="1.5*"/></Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                                            <CheckBox IsChecked="{Binding Enabled,Mode=TwoWay,UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                                                            <TextBlock Grid.Column="1" Text="{Binding Label}" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                                                            <Border Grid.Column="2" Padding="7,2" CornerRadius="9" BorderBrush="#303844" BorderThickness="1" HorizontalAlignment="Left"><TextBlock Text="{Binding Role}" FontSize="10" Foreground="{StaticResource AccentBright}"/></Border>
                                                            <TextBlock Grid.Column="3" Text="{Binding NexusLabel}" Foreground="{StaticResource Muted}" FontSize="10" TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                                                        </Grid>
                                                    </DataTemplate>
                                                </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                                            </ItemsControl>
                                        </StackPanel>
                                    </Border>
                                </DataTemplate>
                            </DataGrid.RowDetailsTemplate>
                            <DataGrid.Columns>
                                <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="ENABLED" Width="72">
                                    <DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                        <DataTemplate>
                                            <CheckBox IsChecked="{Binding StagedEnabled,Mode=TwoWay,UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}" IsThreeState="False" HorizontalAlignment="Center" ToolTip="Turn the whole mod on or off. A partial state means only some add-ons or components are enabled."/>
                                        </DataTemplate>
                                    </DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                </DataGridTemplateColumn>
                                <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="" Width="90">
                                    <DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                        <DataTemplate>
                                            <Border Width="76" Height="48" CornerRadius="5" Background="#0B1016" BorderBrush="{StaticResource Border}" BorderThickness="1" ClipToBounds="True">
                                                <Grid>
                                                    <TextBlock Text="IMG" Foreground="{StaticResource Muted}" FontSize="9" HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                                                    <Image Source="{Binding ThumbnailPath,Converter={StaticResource SafeImage}}" Stretch="UniformToFill"/>
                                                </Grid>
                                            </Border>
                                        </DataTemplate>
                                    </DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                </DataGridTemplateColumn>
                                <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="MOD" Width="2.8*">
                                    <DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                        <DataTemplate>
                                            <StackPanel VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding DisplayName}" FontWeight="SemiBold" TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis" ToolTip="{Binding DisplayName}"/>
                                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding IdentityHint}" Foreground="{StaticResource Muted}" FontSize="11" TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis" ToolTip="{Binding SourceSummary}"/>
                                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding IssueBadge}" Foreground="{StaticResource Warn}" FontSize="10" FontWeight="SemiBold" ToolTip="{Binding IssueReason}">
                                                    <TextBlock.Style>
                                                        <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                                                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                                            <Style.Triggers><DataTrigger Binding="{Binding HasIssue}" Value="True"><Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/></DataTrigger></Style.Triggers>
                                                        </Style>
                                                    </TextBlock.Style>
                                                </TextBlock>
                                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding UpdateBadge}" Foreground="{StaticResource Good}" FontSize="10" FontWeight="SemiBold">
                                                    <TextBlock.Style>
                                                        <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                                                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                                            <Style.Triggers><DataTrigger Binding="{Binding HasUpdate}" Value="True"><Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/></DataTrigger></Style.Triggers>
                                                        </Style>
                                                    </TextBlock.Style>
                                                </TextBlock>
                                            </StackPanel>
                                        </DataTemplate>
                                    </DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                </DataGridTemplateColumn>
                                <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="STATUS" Width="132">
                                    <DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                        <DataTemplate>
                                            <Border HorizontalAlignment="Left">
                                                <Border.Style>
                                                    <Style TargetType="Border" BasedOn="{StaticResource StatusBadge}">
                                                        <Style.Triggers>
                                                            <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding StateLabel}" Value="Enabled">
                                                                <Setter Property="Background" Value="#13241C"/>
                                                                <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="#28553E"/>
                                                            </DataTrigger>
                                                            <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding HasStagedChanges}" Value="True">
                                                                <Setter Property="Background" Value="#272113"/>
                                                                <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="#5B4720"/>
                                                            </DataTrigger>
                                                        </Style.Triggers>
                                                    </Style>
                                                </Border.Style>
                                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding StateLabel}" FontSize="11" FontWeight="SemiBold">

                                                        <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
